list.title: Courses
list.emptyBody: Every course your shop can teach shows up here, ready to put on the board.

edit.depthMarkersHint: <marker>'{depth18}'</marker> prints as “18 meters” or “60 feet” in the diver's unit. Also <marker>'{depth12}'</marker>, <marker>'{depth21}'</marker>, <marker>'{depth30}'</marker> and <marker>'{depth40}'</marker>; add <marker>n</marker> for a bare number in a range. Delete a marker to write the depth yourself.
edit.hiddenFromDivers: Hidden from divers and the session picker.
edit.errorInvalid: That didn't save. Check the fields and try again.
edit.errorFaqIncomplete: Every question needs an answer, and every answer a question.
edit.errorImages: You can keep up to eight gallery photos. Remove one before adding more.
edit.errorUpload: That photo didn't upload. Try a JPG, PNG, or WebP under 5 MB.
edit.errorTooManyPhotos: Add up to {max} new gallery photos per save. Save this batch, then add more.
edit.errorDepthPlaceholder: One of your depth markers is broken, so nothing saved. Write it exactly as '{depth18}'. The choices are '{depth12}', '{depth18}', '{depth21}', '{depth30}' and '{depth40}'. If you would rather write the depth in your own words, delete the marker instead.
edit.conflictMessage: Somebody else changed this page while you had it open, so nothing was saved. What you typed is still here. Copy anything you need, then reload.
edit.subheadDescription: One line under the title, e.g. “How to become a PADI Open Water Diver”.
edit.overviewDescription: A few paragraphs in the diver's words.
edit.pricingDescription: Two lines on one order: your instruction fee and the agency's e-learning fee. The diver pays the total in a single payment.
edit.galleryPhotosHint: (up to eight in total, {max} new per save)
edit.nitroxCompatibleLabel: We can run this course on nitrox
edit.nitroxCompatibleHint: When it is off, sessions of this course never offer divers the enriched-air box. A diver still needs verified nitrox certification before any fill.
edit.enrollDescription: The certification and minimum age come from the agency: {levelAge}, and are not editable.
edit.includedPlaceholder:
6 open water dives
Full rental gear
Light lunch
